plugin.name: vertical_kube
plugin._long: A plugin to show the current workspace row as a cube.

option.name: activate
option._long: Activates the cube with the specified button.

option.name: toggle_panorama
option._long: While the mirrored cube is open, smoothly join the monitors into one panoramic view. Each face shows the monitors' desktops side by side. Requires matching workspace grids.

option.name: rotate_left
option._long: Rotates left with the specified activator.

option.name: rotate_right
option._long: Rotates right with the specified activator.

option.name: rotate_up
option._long: Moves to the workspace row above with the specified activator.

option.name: rotate_down
option._long: Moves to the workspace row below with the specified activator.

option.name: object_enabled
option._long: Place a textured model inside each cube row. Transparent desktops and caps reveal it.

option.name: object_path
option._long: Path to an OBJ or GLB model, or a folder of models. GLB loads meshes with embedded PNG/JPEG textures, base-color materials and looping animation clips. A folder selects a random model on each cube activation, shared across monitors, without immediate repeats when possible. Only files directly inside the folder are selected. Supports positions, normals, triangles and convex polygons. Export concave polygons as triangles. MTL materials and diffuse, specular and opacity textures load automatically. Keep material and texture files with the model. Change the path to reload.

option.name: object_animation
option._long: Loop the selected GLB animation while the cube is open. Supports node transforms, skeletal skinning and morph targets. Disable to show the rest pose.

option.name: object_animation_clip
option._long: Zero-based clip number. Clip names are printed in the Wayfire log when loading. Fox: 0 Survey, 1 Walk, 2 Run. Out-of-range values use the nearest available clip.

option.name: object_animation_speed
option._long: Playback multiplier. 1 is normal speed; 0.5 is half speed.

option.name: object_scale
option._long: Largest model dimension in desktop-height units. Models are automatically centered.

option.name: object_position_x
option._long: Left/right offset from each cube row centre, in desktop-height units. Moves with the cube and is independent of object size and rotation.

option.name: object_position_y
option._long: Vertical offset from each cube row centre, in desktop-height units. Moves with the cube and is independent of object size and rotation.

option.name: object_position_z
option._long: Front/back offset from each cube row centre, in desktop-height units. Moves with the cube and is independent of object size and rotation.

option.name: object_flip_vertical
option._long: Turn an upside-down model upright by rotating it 180 degrees around its local front axis. Keeps textures attached and preserves lighting.

option.name: object_rotation
option._long: Rotate the model around its vertical axis in degrees.

option.name: cinematic_left
option._long: While the cube is open, play a banking camera arc and return smoothly. Press another direction to queue the next sweep.

option.name: cinematic_right
option._long: While the cube is open, play a banking camera arc and return smoothly. Press another direction to queue the next sweep.

option.name: cinematic_up
option._long: While the cube is open, play a banking camera arc and return smoothly. Press another direction to queue the next sweep.

option.name: cinematic_down
option._long: While the cube is open, play a banking camera arc and return smoothly. Press another direction to queue the next sweep.

option.name: cinematic_duration
option._long: Length of each cinematic camera move in seconds.

option.name: cinematic_strength
option._long: Amount of orbit, banking and camera pullback.

option.name: mist_enabled
option._long: Soft animated smoke around each cube row, synchronized across monitors.

option.name: searchlights_enabled
option._long: Colored beams sweep out from each cube row centre, changing hue. Stylized glow, with opaque surfaces blocking hidden beam sections.

option.name: searchlights_refraction
option._long: Treat each cube row as an optical solid. Bend rays at its sides and caps, including internal reflection. Uses the deformed envelope; decorative cap relief and rounded edges are excluded.

option.name: mirror_outputs
option._long: Show the activating monitor's cube on every monitor with shared controls. On exit, select the same workspace on each monitor, clamped to its workspace grid. Disable for independent per-monitor cubes.

option.name: deform
option._long: Specifies the deformation to be used.

option.name: light
option._long: Specifies whether to use lighting.

group._long: Creates a larger cube showing only windows without background.

option.name: enable_window_popout
option._long: Enables a separate floating window cube, retaining native window blur with the workspace wallpaper as its backdrop. Disable to render complete workspaces on the main cube. Change while the cube is closed.

option.name: popout_scale
option._long: Sets how much larger the window popout cube should be compared to the main cube. 1.0 = same size, 1.2 = 20% larger.

option.name: window_thickness
option._long: Extrude each pop-out window's border pixels inward. Zero disables. Requires GLES 3.2; per-window silhouette processing costs GPU time.

option.name: window_edge_cutoff
option._long: Ignore faint shadows when locating the border. Lower for translucent decorations; higher to exclude more shadow.

option.name: per_window_depth
option._long: Pop out each window at its own depth, preserving stacking order. Uses additional rendering and GPU memory.

option.name: window_depth_spacing
option._long: Extra separation per window, relative to the normal popout distance.

option.name: popout_opacity
option._long: Sets the opacity of the window popout cube. 1.0 = fully opaque, 0.5 = semi-transparent.

option.name: desktop_opacity
option._long: Opacity of cube desktop faces. Popped-out windows keep their separate opacity.

option.name: desktop_blur
option._long: Frosted glass using the configured Wayfire blur method. Requires desktop opacity below 1.

option.name: cap_blur
option._long: Frosted glass behind translucent caps using the configured Wayfire blur method.

option.name: dynamic_lighting
option._long: Animate three hue-changing point lights inside each cube, illuminating faces, windows and caps.

group._long: Settings for the top and bottom caps of the cube.

option.name: enable_caps
option._long: Enables rendering of top and bottom caps on the cube. Caps are N-sided polygons matching the number of workspace faces.

option.name: cap_picture_underlay
option._long: Fill transparent picture areas with the top or bottom cap colour. Disable to preserve the picture's own transparency.

option.name: cap_rotation_top
option._long: Rotate only the top cap picture around its centre, in degrees.

option.name: cap_rotation_bottom
option._long: Rotate only the bottom cap picture around its centre, in degrees.

option.name: cap_bump_3d
option._long: Displace the cap mesh into real 3D ripples, including cap pictures. Adds geometry and rendering cost; edges remain attached to the cube.

option.name: cap_bump_mapping
option._long: Animate raised ripple lighting on the cube caps. Disable for a smooth cap surface.

option.name: cap_alpha
option._long: Sets the transparency of the cube caps. 1.0 = fully opaque, 0.0 = fully transparent.

option.name: cap_color_top
option._long: Sets the color/tint for the top cap of the cube.

option.name: cap_color_bottom
option._long: Sets the color/tint for the bottom cap of the cube.

option.name: cap_texture_top
option._long: Loads the specified texture for the top cap. Leave empty to use solid color.

option.name: cap_texture_bottom
option._long: Loads the specified texture for the bottom cap. Leave empty to use solid color.

option.name: zoom
option._long: Sets the level of zoom out. Setting the value to **0.0** means to not zoom out.

option.name: initial_animation
option._long: Sets the initial animation duration in milliseconds.

option.name: speed_zoom
option._long: Sets the speed factor for zooming.

option.name: speed_spin_horiz
option._long: Sets the velocity of horizontal spinning.

option.name: speed_spin_vert
option._long: Sets the velocity of vertical spinning.

option.name: shader_resolution_scale
option._long: Render the nebula at this fraction of output resolution and smoothly upscale. 1.0 is full detail; 0.75 reduces shader pixels by about 44%. Other cube surfaces stay full resolution.

option.name: background_mode
option._long: Selects a solid color, flat picture, skydome, cubemap, or animated shader.

option.name: background_image
option._long: PNG or JPEG picture stretched to fill the output in image mode. Use an absolute path. If unavailable, the background color is used.

option.name: background
option._long: Sets the background color for the simple background mode.

option.name: skydome_mirror
option._long: Specifies whether to mirror skydome.

option.name: skydome_texture
option._long: Loads the specified texture for the skydome background mode.

option.name: cubemap_image
option._long: Loads the specified image for the cubemap background mode.
